scenarios.detail: Executed in IsolatedSimulationStore across 5000 personas (5000 registered, 4300 authenticated, 20 duplicate registrations blocked, 700 failed auth attempts audited).
Verified 2150 block/unblock pairs and 2150 blocked-channel message rejections.
Persisted 4300 messages and blocked 2150 duplicate idempotency keys in isolated store.
Verified media policy validator (80 accepted, 60 rejected) enforcing 60s live audio cap and approved size/duration bounds.
Verified 2150 room bookings, 2150 booking conflict rejections, and 2150 refunds in isolated store.
Verified 2150 atomic wallet transactions, 2150 duplicate tx blocks, and plan durations {'24h': 717, '7d': 717, '30d': 716}.
Verified 2150 simulated ad reward claims and 2150 duplicate reward blocks without real ad networks.
Verified 125 Super Owner test grants and blocked 2025 unauthorized non-owner escalations.
Inventoried 60 screen/page/view files and 11 test files statically; interactive Flutter widget/integration execution and Firebase Emulator Suite were not run inside Termux CLI.
Live peer-to-peer WebRTC media transport and physical hardware biometric sensors cannot be verified from Termux CLI.
